name: hero-video-dialog
title: Hero Video Dialog
description: A video thumbnail with a frosted play button; pressing it opens a player that springs in over a blurred, darkened backdrop.

moworks.author: magicui

options.animationStyle: from-center | from-bottom | from-top | from-left | from-right | fade | top-in-bottom-out | left-in-right-out

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: el is the holder (the scene's frame: the backdrop covers it). thumbnail / media: picture paths; for a real clip put a HyperFrames <video class="clip"> in .mw-hv-player. The play glyph is lucide's Play (ISC).
